distractors.reason: We don't say 'depend in' in English. 'In' appears in 'interested in' or 'succeed in', but not after 'depend'.
We don't say 'depend for' with this meaning. 'For' appears in 'wait for' or 'apply for', but not after 'depend'.
We don't say 'depend to'. 'To' appears in 'listen to' or 'belong to', but 'depend' always takes 'on' here.

example_sentence: Your chance of getting into university may ___ on your exam results.
l1_interference: Türkçe'de 'bağlı olmak' anlamı, bağlanılan şeyi hâl ekiyle gösterir. İngilizcede ise 'depend' fiilinin yanında ayrı bir edat gerekir. Öğrenciler bu yüzden 'depend of' veya 'depend in' gibi yanlış edatlar kullanabilir.
explanation: In English, 'depend' is almost always followed by 'on' when one thing is controlled by or needs another. Think of 'on' as showing what the result rests on.

related_collocations.example: You can rely on your teacher for advice.
I can always count on my friends.
Try to concentrate on your studies before the exam.

memory_tip: DEPEND ON = one thing rests on another (your career depends on your grades)
